title: EditReward: A Human-Aligned Reward Model for Instruction-Guided Image Editing
authors: Keming Wu, Sicong Jiang, Max Ku, Ping Nie, Minghao Liu, Wenhu Chen
abstract: Recently, we have witnessed great progress in image editing with natural language instructions. Several closed-source models like GPT-Image-1, Seedream, and Google-Nano-Banana have shown highly promising progress. However, the open-source models are still lagging. The main bottleneck is the lack of a reliable reward model to scale up high-quality synthetic training data. To address this critical bottleneck, we built EditReward, trained with our new large-scale human preference dataset, meticulously annotated by trained experts following a rigorous protocol containing over 200K preference pairs. EditReward demonstrates superior alignment with human preferences in instruction-guided image editing tasks. Experiments show that EditReward achieves state-of-the-art human correlation on established benchmarks such as GenAI-Bench, AURORA-Bench, ImagenHub, and our new EditReward-Bench, outperforming a wide range of VLM-as-judge models. Furthermore, we use EditReward to select a high-quality subset from the existing noisy ShareGPT-4o-Image dataset. We train Step1X-Edit on the selected subset, which shows significant improvement over training on the full set. This demonstrates EditReward's ability to serve as a reward model to scale up high-quality training data for image editing. Furthermore, its strong alignment suggests potential for advanced applications like reinforcement learning-based post-training and test-time scaling of image editing models. EditReward with its training dataset will be released to help the community build more high-quality image editing training datasets.

zh_title: EditReward：面向指令引导图像编辑的与人类对齐的奖励模型
zh_abstract: 近来，基于自然语言指令的图像编辑取得了长足进展。GPT-Image-1、Seedream 与 Google-Nano-Banana 等若干闭源模型展现出极具前景的进展，开源模型却仍然落后。主要瓶颈在于缺乏可靠的奖励模型来扩大高质量合成训练数据的规模。为突破这一关键瓶颈，我们构建了 EditReward，并用我们新的大规模人类偏好数据集进行训练——该数据集由受训专家遵循严格流程精心标注，包含超过 20 万条偏好对。EditReward 在指令引导图像编辑任务上展现出与人类偏好的优越一致性。实验表明，EditReward 在 GenAI-Bench、AURORA-Bench、ImagenHub 以及我们新提出的 EditReward-Bench 等成熟基准上取得了最佳的人类相关性，优于大量「以视觉语言模型为裁判」的模型。此外，我们用 EditReward 从现有的含噪 ShareGPT-4o-Image 数据集中筛选高质量子集，并在该子集上训练 Step1X-Edit，其表现相比在全集上训练有显著提升。这证明了 EditReward 作为奖励模型扩大高质量图像编辑训练数据规模的能力。其强大的对齐性还显示出在基于强化学习的后训练与测试时扩展等高级应用上的潜力。我们将发布 EditReward 及其训练数据集，以帮助社区构建更高质量的图像编辑训练数据集。
